newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 23,000T U.S. wheat-traders.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 23,000T U.S. wheat-traders.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have joinlty invited tenders to buy a total of 23,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 1:00 p.m. (0400 GMT) on Friday, traders said.
Cheiljedang wants to buy 9,500 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges, including the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah Flour is seeking the remaining 13,500 tonnes at fixed prices, they said.
Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to South Korea's southwestern port of Pusan.
